execution_failure_policy: If Tool-agent has no scored output, keep the RuleAudit decision; no label is invented.
rule: Use RuleAudit for all deterministic numeric, statistical, table, claim-template, and high-confidence candidate-rendering decisions.
selected_on: development protocol only; no test metrics used for gate selection
tool_deference: Use Tool-agent only for predeclared visual-semantic families when RuleAudit has no visual-semantic prediction.
